plugins.name: ac-code-skill
plugins.description: Orchestrate a fleet of six principal-level subagents (Frontend, Backend, Cyber Security, end-to-end Tester, DevOps, and an AI Agent Engineer for AI/LLM repos) over a codebase, coordinated through one shared memory. Agents review read-only in parallel, check for outdated/dead dependencies and dead code, self-improve, and each applies its own approved fixes sequentially in the gated fix phase. Fixes are approval-gated; deploys auto-run with rollback. 'run ac-code-skill' runs the whole pipeline in one prompt, and an empty repo triggers a from-scratch interview.
